_comment: Item pool. kind 'catch' = battle-only orbs (catchMod scales base catch chance); 'heal' = HP restore (in/out of battle); 'cure' = removes status conditions (cures: 'all' or [statusIds]); 'revive' = revives a fainted creature to fraction of max HP (pause-menu only). price = shop cost in coins.

snare_orb.name: Snare Orb
snare_orb.desc: A woven orb that snares a weakened wild creature.

great_orb.name: Great Orb
great_orb.desc: A reinforced orb with a far better snare rate.

remedy_leaf.name: Remedy Leaf
remedy_leaf.desc: A bitter leaf that cures any status condition.

revive_seed.name: Revive Seed
revive_seed.desc: Revives a fainted creature to half HP. Too potent to use mid-battle.
